parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.015684 vs 1.005477). It seems reducing the batch size further might have introduced instability or insufficient convergence per step. Reverting to my best: DEPTH=6, BATCH=262144, LR=0.05. Next, I'll test adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if regularization helps the current stable configuration.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to the previous best configuration (DEPTH=6, BATCH=262144, LR=0.05) to stabilize training and improve generalization.
